'''Business and economy'''
*[[Proposed acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft]]
**[[United States federal judge|United States judge]] [[Jacqueline Scott Corley]] approves [[technology company]] [[Microsoft]]'s $69 billion [[Mergers and acquisitions|acquisition]] of [[video game publisher]] [[Activision Blizzard]], the [[List of most expensive video game acquisitions|largest video game acquisition]] in history, dismissing the [[Federal Trade Commission]]'s [[United States antitrust law|antitrust]] [[injunction]] request. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-judge-rules-microsoft-deal-buy-activision-can-go-forward-2023-07-11/ (Reuters)]

**[[Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis (2021–present)|Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis]]
***[[Azerbaijan]]'s [[State Border Service of Azerbaijan|State Border Service]] temporarily closes the [[Lachin corridor]], the only road between [[Armenia]] and the disputed [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] region, alleging [[smuggling]] by the [[Armenian Red Cross Society]]. '''Science and technology'''
*The [[Anthropocene Working Group]] identifies [[Crawford Lake (Halton Region)|Crawford Lake]] near [[Milton, Ontario|Milton]], [[Ontario]], [[Canada]], as the origin of the proposed [[Anthropocene]] [[Epoch (geology)|epoch]] due to its [[varve]]s which provide a comprehensive [[geologic record]] of recent [[environmental change]]. [https://tribune.net.ph/2023/07/12/canadian-lake-ground-zero-for-anthropocene-epoch/ (AFP via ''Daily Tribune'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Testosterone regulations in women's athletics]]
**The [[European Court of Human Rights]] rules in favor of [[South Africa]]n [[Middle-distance running|runner]] [[Caster Semenya]], stating that Semenya's previous appeals against [[World Athletics]]' [[testosterone]] regulations were inadequately reviewed, potentially enabling her to recontest these rules due to her [[hyperandrogenism]].
